manifest.name: dsh-timeline-enhance
manifest.description: DSH Web UI plugin: auto-fold chat timeline processes and Deep diving fun tips

bundle.text:
# The dsh-timeline-enhance bundle patch (declared by the `dsh.bundle.patch`
# manifest field): one additive row mounting the browser half. The layer is
# applied after the profile template layers (@deepseek-ai/dsh-base and
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app for the web profile); it only inserts, so it can
# never override official rows.
- insert:
    - id: timeline-enhance
      name: dsh-timeline-enhance

readme.text: **Chat timeline auto-collapse + Deep diving playful tips · A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin** [](LICENSE) **Install** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:lianginx/dsh-timeline-enhance ``` English · [简体中文](./README.zh.md) --- A tiny plugin for a big readability win.

- **After the answer, it tidies up** — the 20+ intermediate steps collapse into one line. Need details? One click to expand.
- **While you wait, it keeps you company** — instead of a frozen `Deep diving...`, a small, friendly hint shows what the agent is actually doing.

You can turn either off in `Settings → Timeline Enhance` — each has a live preview.

| Auto-collapse | Playful tips | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | | | | Collapse 20+ noisy steps into `▸ Collapsed 3 steps · Tools 2`. One click to expand. | Context-aware fun hints like `Sending the tools out for a walk…` while Deep diving. |
